subject: Quick 15-min office hours — BrightGrid usage spike & next steps
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Ayla Summers <ayla@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15-min office hours — BrightGrid usage spike & next steps

Hi Ayla —

Congrats on the uptick this morning — our system flagged a sustained token surge in your BrightGrid org. Thanks for trying Redwood! I wanted to offer a short, hands-on 15-minute office hours session to:

- walk through the usage profile we saw,
- surface quick tuning tips (batching/kv cache) to reduce costs, and
- answer any questions from your engineers.

Two quick options (PDT):
- Today 4:00–4:15pm (15m)
- Tomorrow 10:00–10:15am (15m)

If those don't work, send a couple times that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve looped in Vanessa from our SDR/solutions team so we can coordinate an agenda and bring a short checklist for your CTO/engineers.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

--
Attachment: brightgrid-usage-snapshot.csv (csv - summary only)

-----
From: Ayla Summers <ayla@brightgrid.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:48:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min office hours — BrightGrid usage spike & next steps

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up — appreciate the proactive reach. We are seeing the same spike; it looks like a new batch job kicked off overnight. I’m interested in a quick session but would prefer late afternoon today if possible. My CTO (Marcus Hale) would like to join — copying his email below.

Also: we have a short security questionnaire the platform team expects we answer before tooling demos. I attached it here. Can your technical person confirm data retention and KV caching behavior for private deployments?

Best,
Ayla
Head of Integrations, BrightGrid
ayla@brightgrid.ai | (617) 555-1799

--
Attachment: brightgrid-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf - company questionnaire)

-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Ayla Summers <ayla@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min office hours — BrightGrid usage spike & next steps

Hi Ayla —

Great to meet you over email — and welcome to Redwood. Glad Marcus can join. We can absolutely confirm the details in a brief call: data retention, KV cache behavior, and what we can guarantee for a Private (VPC) deployment vs Hosted.

I booked two tentative 15-minute office-hours slots below; please pick the one that fits and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda:

- Today 4:15–4:30pm PDT (I freed up an extra 15m after Ben's note)
- Tomorrow 10:00–10:15am PDT

Proposed agenda (15m):
1) Quick usage snapshot & what triggered the alert (Ben) — 4 min
2) KV cache / retention and deployment options (Soojin) — 6 min
3) Quick next steps + security questionnaire handoff — 5 min

If you prefer a deeper technical deep-dive we can extend to 30m and loop in a solutions engineer. I’ve attached our onboarding checklist so your team can prepare; Soojin, can you confirm you'll cover the retention/KV pieces?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
SDR Team Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0149

--
Attachment: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf - prep checklist)

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Ayla Summers <ayla@brightgrid.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min office hours — BrightGrid usage spike & next steps

Hi Ayla —

I’ll join the slot you pick and cover KV cache semantics, prefix caching options, and the differences between Hosted vs Private retention policies. Quick note: for Private (VPC) customers we can configure retention limits and KMS integration; I’ll bring the example settings and a short runbook.

Pre-call ask (2 min): could you share which env triggered the spike (staging/prod) and whether you’re using streaming or response-mode generation? That helps me tailor the checklist.

I also dropped a short pre-read link here: https://redwood.ai/docs/onboarding/quick-checklist (internal doc — will include in invite).

See you soon —
Soojin Lee
Applied ML / Solutions, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
